intro.title: White Zircon Stone
intro.descriptionHtml: White Zircon stones have been admired ever since it was discovered and started being used as a gemstone. Ancient Hindu poets have described the magical wish-fulfilling tree, Kalpavriksha, to be made of gemstones and its leaves to be made of Zircon stones/Zircon rock. Zircon stones are semi-precious gemstones that have the history of being used in the middle ages as a stone which helps in peaceful sleep, bring prosperity and wisdom.

tabs.tab2_heading: Who should wear White Zircon gemstone?
tabs.tab1_description:
White Zircon gemstone is a variety of zirconium silicate-based gemstones found in a variety of colors. It is frequently substituted for diamonds due to its lustrous and transparent appearance. White Zircon is typically faceted for use in jewelry, but it can also be cabochon-cut or tumbled for other applications. Its hardness on the Mohs scale ranges from 7 to 7.5, making it resistant to everyday wear. The stone has been prized since antiquity and was historically thought to bestow good fortune.

White Zircon is extracted from numerous locations across the globe. The nearly colorless shape of this gemstone is especially desirable because it captures light with such brilliance, emitting blue and orange flashes of fire when exposed to sunlight or artificial light. White zircons have a higher refractive index and dispersion rate than diamonds, allowing them to sparkle spectacularly despite being less expensive than diamonds.

White Zircon provides prosperity and abundance to the wearer and his or her family. The sparkling gemstone benefits the relationships between women, giving them an advantage over the other. The white zircon stone provides harmony and balance by removing blocks in the energy flow of the wearer.

According to white zircon's astrological importance, it is thought to safeguard the mind and body and to contain specific traits that benefit the user in a beneficial way. White zircon is a potent gemstone that attracts wisdom, wealth, self-respect, and self-assurance. These gemstones are strongly associated with feelings of love and joy, and are believed to increase the wearer's happiness.

White zircon is a treasured gemstone with a variety of distinctive qualities and significances. Its origins date back to antiquity, making it a popular jewelry choice among collectors. Scientific and metaphysical properties, such as the ability to refract light in captivating ways, distinguish white zircons as unique.

White Zircon Gem is connected with imagination, manifestation, clarity of thinking, mental alertness, and focus. It is believed that sporting jewelry made from such a stone can help you remain grounded and connected to your power, allowing you to more easily manifest your dreams.

White zircon is regarded as auspicious for those with creative minds, as it is believed to make the wearer appealing and popular.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although White Zircon gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing White Zircon. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Crown Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

It is common knowledge that white zircon can protect one from harmful energies and boost one's self-assurance and self-confidence. People who wear it are likely to be invited to more joyful events, such as birthday parties and weddings. White zircon is a sparkling and suitable engagement ring also used as a substitute of diamond too.

In addition, white zircon improves communication with the divine and higher realms, thereby enhancing both professional and personal relationships on a deeper level. This semi-precious stone emits an aura of tranquility and harmony when worn frequently. Highly recommended for those who feel alone or who have given up their faith.

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated White Zircon gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated White Zircon gemstones.

White Zircon Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Cambodia is renowned for its production of high-quality white zircon gemstones. Sri Lanka, also referred to as Ceylon, is also a significant source of white zircon. In addition to Australia, Burma and Madagascar, white zircon is also found in Tanzania.

Observe their Color:

As their name suggests, white zircon gemstones have an appearance that is colorless or very close to being colorless.

Notice their Clarity:

They are well-known for their brilliance and high refractive index, which gives them a vibrant and sparkling appearance.

Examine their Inclusions:

White zircon gemstones may contain a variety of inclusions, which are natural flaws or foreign substances trapped within the gem during its formation.

See their Shape:

White zircon can be polished into many different shapes, including emerald-cut, oval, round, cabochon, cushion, pear, and square. Other shapes include pear and square.

Check the Carats:

For White Zircon of gem quality, the raw White Zircon is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, White Zircon weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because White Zircon is sold by weight, White Zircon prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity White Zircon has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated White Zircon

Due to treatments the White Zircon stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated White Zircon do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase White Zircon gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our White Zircon are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy White Zircon from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used White Zircon gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, White Zircon is a good choice for you. tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated White Zircon gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of White Zircon is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

White zircon of the highest quality is colorless to the naked eye.

Cut

Best quality White Zircon stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

White Zircon of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger White Zircon are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of White Zircon rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

White zircon of the highest quality has a sparkling transparency to light.

Traders deal in White Zircon stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

White Zircon gemstone Price

The most prized white zircon gemstones are those with superior clarity, brilliance, and colorlessness. These gemstones are highly sought after by collectors and gem enthusiasts due to their diamond-like appearance. Make sure to choose an untreated one.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. White Zircon has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated White Zircon stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated White Zircon gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 8,400 to INR 27,265 (USD 105 to USD 340).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic White Zircon?

The best way to check the authenticity of White Zircon is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our White Zircon are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the White Zircon carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a White Zircon is genuine. Lab-created (fake) White Zircon have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural White Zircon, but if you find flaws, then your White Zircon is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created White Zircon are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural White Zircon. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the White Zircon, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your White Zircon from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the White Zircon. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the White Zircon. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

White Zircon Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

White zircon stone requires proper maintenance to preserve its beauty. Use gentle soap and warm water with a soft brush or cloth to clean the gems.

After cleaning, rinse thoroughly and never leave soaked for extended periods, as this may cause discoloration.

A good practice is to wipe the stone down after every use. Wrap your white zircon stones in cotton or velvet when storing them to prevent them from scratching other jewelry pieces.
